3. A complete resummation and sampler under uniform pin-Gram control

A second result gives a precise sufficient representation for the requested treatment of disconnected contributions.

Consider a bounded-degree tensor graph with fixed bond dimension  $D$ , normalized rational edge states, and fixed-size output blocks. For every local measurement pin  $M$  needed by the supplied POVMs, suppose its physical Gram matrix has the form

 $T_v^\dagger(M\otimes I)T_v
=a_v(M)\bigl(I+E_v(M)\bigr),
\qquad
\|E_v(M)\|\le\kappa. \tag{10}$ All matrices and scalars are explicitly represented and paid. A zero scalar must correspond to an exactly zero Gram matrix, and the unpinned represented state must have positive normalization.

For graph degree  $\Delta$ , the explicit sufficient bound

 $\boxed{
\kappa\le\frac{1}{1024(\Delta+1)^3}
} \tag{11}$ permits full joint sampling in polynomial bit work, including exponentially rare nonzero prefixes.

This is a theorem about a supplied representation. It is not a theorem that every native evolution possesses that representation.

Exact treatment of disconnected contributions

For a fixed prefix, factor out the known local scalars:

 $Z=\left(\prod_v a_v\right)\Xi,
\qquad
\Xi=\operatorname{Tr}\!\left[
\omega_E\bigotimes_v(I+E_v)
\right].$ Expanding over occupied vertices gives connected-polymer activities

 $w(C)=\operatorname{Tr}\!\left[
\omega_E\bigotimes_{v\in C}E_v
\right],
\qquad
|w(C)|\le\kappa^{|C|}.$ The product structure of the edge reference makes distinct connected components factor exactly, including for mixed entangled edge states.

Thus

 $\Xi=\sum_{\text{compatible families }\mathcal F}
\prod_{C\in\mathcal F}w(C).$ This identity retains all numbers of disconnected polymers. Their total absolute mass is not used as an acceptance probability.

Let  $b=4(\Delta+1)^2$ . Under (11),

 $\sup_v\sum_{C\ni v}|w(C)|e^{2|C|}
\le\frac{e^2\kappa}{1-be^2\kappa},$ which satisfies the convergence criterion. Keeping logarithmic clusters whose union has at most  $L$  vertices incurs error at most

 $N e^{-L}. \tag{12}$ These contributions can be computed without enumerating polymer multisets. Define

\omega_E\bigotimes_{v\in W}(I+E_v)
\right],
\qquad
